reason: I'd try the free tier, but three dishes a month is about all I'd actually cook on weeknights, and ChatGPT already gives me a pad kra pao recipe with substitutes for nothing. I don't see why I'd pay on top of the takeaway I'm still going to order.
objection: A free AI chatbot already does this. Unless Chef Jiw is clearly more authentic and faster than just asking ChatGPT, the $2.99 is paying for something I already have.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free dishes the hands-free voice coaching actually got a real Thai dinner on the table in 20-25 minutes using what my normal supermarket stocks, noticeably better than a chatbot, I'd pay the $2.99.
